name: answer-buttons
description: Puts buttons under Claude's questions, which Claude tags "[Question]:" with an "Options:" line of numbered «quoted» options: one button per option (one or pick-any), Yes/No when none are listed, and Other for typed text; a rhetorical question gets none; Submit sends your answers and Dismiss closes them; nothing else closes open questions, not a later reply, a typed message or another session's message
